description: Canonical authoring representation derived from server metadata and defaults. Top-level optional keys may be omitted or null. The existing HTTP validator separately coerces top-level numeric strings, enforces their declared bounds and permits unknown/legacy fields; it does not enforce this whole nested schema. Runtime strategy/version/timeframe checks remain authoritative. Cooldown durations may be omitted by legacy configs and then fall back to their corresponding windows.

atr_cap_multiplier.description: SUPERSEDED by volatility_tolerance. Bounded the weighted blend at this multiple of the SHORT ATR.
atr_cap_multiplier.x-mangrove-effect: None on a strategy using atr_width_dial. On a weighted_atr strategy this is what made the weight pair inert past a long weight of roughly 6-12% (#1052).
atr_cap_multiplier.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

atr_long_weight.description: SUPERSEDED by volatility_tolerance. Weight of the daily ATR in the weighted-blend stop model, and always 1 - atr_short_weight rather than independent.
atr_long_weight.x-mangrove-effect: None on a strategy using atr_width_dial. Derived, never independently effective.
atr_long_weight.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

atr_period.description: ATR lookback in bars (default 14) used to measure volatility for stop sizing.
atr_period.x-mangrove-effect: Higher smooths the volatility estimate (steadier, slower-reacting stops). Lower reacts faster to recent volatility (choppier stops).
atr_period.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

atr_short_weight.description: SUPERSEDED by volatility_tolerance. Weight of the signal-timeframe ATR in the weighted-blend stop model. Readable on a strategy created under that model; refused on any write.
atr_short_weight.x-mangrove-effect: None on a strategy using atr_width_dial. On a weighted_atr strategy, higher favours the signal timeframe's own volatility -- though the cap made settings past a few percent of long weight indistinguishable (#1052).
atr_short_weight.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

atr_volatility_factor.description: SUPERSEDED by volatility_tolerance. Multiplied the blended ATR to give the stop distance. The dial's two endpoint factors carry this instead, one at each end of the width.
atr_volatility_factor.x-mangrove-effect: None on a strategy using atr_width_dial. On a weighted_atr strategy, higher widens the stop and shrinks the position for the same risk.
atr_volatility_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

cooldown_bars.description: Bars to wait between trades on the same asset.
cooldown_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Higher spaces trades out (reduces overtrading and whipsaw); lower allows quicker re-entry.
cooldown_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

long_cooldown_bars.description: Bars to deny new entries once long_loss_limit trips. Also the latch duration a drawdown breaker trip uses.
long_cooldown_bars.x-mangrove-effect: As short_cooldown_bars, and it doubles as the drawdown breaker's cooldown, so raising it lengthens that halt too.

long_loss_limit.description: Consecutive losses inside long_window_bars that trip the long cooldown. Should exceed short_loss_limit, or the long rule never fires first.
long_loss_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower trips the longer pause sooner; higher reserves it for a deeper losing streak.

long_window_bars.description: Lookback, in bars, over which long_loss_limit is counted.
long_window_bars.x-mangrove-effect: As short_window_bars, over the longer horizon.

short_cooldown_bars.description: Bars to deny new entries once short_loss_limit trips. Positions already open still exit.
short_cooldown_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer sits out more of a bad regime at the cost of missing the recovery; shorter resumes sooner.

short_loss_limit.description: Consecutive losses inside short_window_bars that trip the short cooldown.
short_loss_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower trips the cooldown sooner after a losing run; higher tolerates more losses before pausing.

short_window_bars.description: Lookback, in bars, over which short_loss_limit is counted.
short_window_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Wider counts losses over more history, so the limit trips more readily; narrower makes it a burst detector.

max_drawdown_halt_limit.description: HARD capital-floor kill switch (0.20 = 20%). Distinct from max_drawdown_limit: measured from the strategy's INITIAL DEPLOYED CAPITAL (initial_balance, fixed at creation), not a rolling peak, on CLOSED (realized) equity, checked before each bar. Live (the eval service, single and bulk): once realized losses reach this fraction of deployed capital, new entries are denied that bar AND the strategy status flips to 'inactive' so it stops ticking -- a ONE-WAY halt that requires the user to MANUALLY restart the strategy (unlike the auto-resuming max_drawdown_limit); exits still run on the breach bar and the halt reason is recorded in execution_state.halt. Backtest: enforced only when the caller passes enforce_capital_floor=True to managers.services.evaluate_bar; from the breach bar to the end of the run no new entries are placed, open positions keep exiting via their own stops and exit rules (nothing is force-closed), and the halt record is on risk_manager.halt. null disables the floor.
max_drawdown_halt_limit.x-mangrove-effect: The absolute stop-loss on deployed capital. Lower protects more capital but ends the strategy sooner; higher tolerates a deeper loss before the one-way halt. Not a sizing knob. Where it is enforced (live eval always; backtests with enforce_capital_floor=True), do not build a separate floor.
max_drawdown_halt_limit.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_drawdown_limit.description: SOFT max-drawdown circuit breaker (0.20 = 20%). A binary halt: once CLOSED (realized) equity draws down this far from its high-water mark, the risk manager denies all new entries (last_denial_reason='max_drawdown'). Peak-relative and measured on closed equity (an unrealized round-trip does NOT trip it). On trip it latches a cooldown equal to the strategy's per-timeframe long cooldown bars; existing positions still exit during that window, and when the cooldown expires the high-water mark re-baselines to current equity so the strategy AUTO-RESUMES from a clean slate (it does NOT stay halted forever, even when flat). null disables the breaker.
max_drawdown_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower halts new entries sooner on a losing run (safer, but can sit out a recovery); higher lets the strategy draw down further before stopping. This is a safety backstop, not a strategy-character knob -- it does NOT resize positions. Enforced by RiskManager.can_place_trade whenever the RiskManager is built with this limit: the live eval service (single and bulk) always builds it that way; a backtest enforces it only when its RiskManager is built with managers.services.risk_manager_from_execution_config (or otherwise given max_drawdown_limit). Where it is enforced, do not build a separate drawdown stop.
max_drawdown_limit.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_bars.description: Maximum bars to hold any position before a forced exit.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets trades run longer; lower forces earlier time-based exits.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_time_hours.description: Maximum position hold time in hours (null = no limit).
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Lower forces earlier time-based exits; null/higher lets trades run indefinitely on time.
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_open_positions.x-mangrove-effect: Higher allows more simultaneous exposure (more diversification but more aggregate risk); lower is more selective with less aggregate exposure.
max_open_positions.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_risk_per_trade.description: Fraction of account equity risked per trade (0.01 = 1%). Position size is derived from this and the stop distance.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-effect: Higher risks more per trade: bigger positions, larger gains AND larger drawdowns. Lower is more conservative: smaller positions, smaller swings.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trade_amount.description: Absolute cap on dollar size per trade.
max_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-effect: Higher permits more churn; lower throttles activity.
max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_units_per_trade.description: Absolute cap on units per trade.
max_units_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_asset_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum asset balance, in asset units, the strategy holds outside open trades.
min_asset_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more of the asset out of reach of sell trades and core sells, and takes more cash to reach; lower frees more of the asset for trading.

min_balance_days.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Number of equal daily orders used to bring a side up to its minimum balance.
min_balance_days.x-mangrove-effect: Higher spreads the minimum-balance orders over more days at smaller size; lower reaches the minimum sooner with larger orders.

min_balance_threshold.description: Cash reserve fraction held back from new entries (0.1 = 10%). v1 reserves this fraction of cash; v2 reserves this fraction of account value (cash + open positions at market). An entry may only use cash above the reserve; when no cash is deployable the entry is denied (insufficient_cash / insufficient_cash_v2_account_reserve). It never halts the strategy and never closes positions.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash idle and makes entries smaller or rarer as the account shrinks; lower lets entries use more of the balance. Not a drawdown stop; see max_drawdown_limit and max_drawdown_halt_limit.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_cash_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum cash balance the strategy holds after the worst-case loss of every open trade.
min_cash_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash out of reach of buy trades and core buys, so entries are smaller or rarer; lower frees more cash for trading.

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Hard floor on stop distance as a fraction of entry price (crypto minimum), applied after ATR sizing.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher enforces a wider minimum stop; lower allows tighter stops down to the floor.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_trade_amount.description: Minimum trade size in dollars; smaller intended trades are skipped.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-effect: Higher skips more small signals; lower allows smaller trades.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

position_size_calc.description: Sizing-engine version ('v1', 'v2' or 'v3'). Pinned at creation and immutable. 'v3' holds an asset balance and a cash balance, sizes against equity net of open risk, and requires the position_size_calc 'v3' parameters.
position_size_calc.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the sizing algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy.

profit_threshold_pct.description: Profit threshold (5%% default) above which a position counts as 'winning' for the time-based exit logic.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher requires a larger gain before a position is treated as winning; lower treats smaller gains as wins.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

rebalance_band.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Absolute deviation of the asset weight from target_asset_weight that triggers a rebalance order (0.05 = 5 points).
rebalance_band.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets the split drift further before a rebalance order, so fewer core orders; lower holds the split closer to target with more core orders and more fees.

reward_factor.description: Risk/reward target. Take-profit distance = reward_factor * stop_distance.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-effect: Higher sets a wider profit target: lower win rate but bigger wins. Lower sets a tighter target: higher win rate but smaller wins.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

stop_gap_allowance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Fraction of the stop price a stop fill is assumed to miss by when computing the worst-case loss of a trade (0.01 = 1%).
stop_gap_allowance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more risk per open trade, leaving less available cash and smaller positions; lower counts less.

stop_model.description: Which stop model the strategy uses: 'atr_width_dial' (one parameter, volatility_tolerance, positioned on the ATR width) or 'weighted_atr' (superseded: a weighted blend of two ATRs, capped). Pinned at creation and immutable.
stop_model.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the stop algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy -- it would move every stop the strategy takes.

taker_fee_rate.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Venue fee per fill as a fraction of notional, charged in cash (0.004 = 0.4%).
taker_fee_rate.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more cost per fill, raising the risk of each trade and lowering available cash. Models the venue; not a strategy-character knob.

target_asset_weight.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Target share of core value held in the asset (0.8 = 80% asset, 20% cash; 0 = all cash).
target_asset_weight.x-mangrove-effect: Higher holds more of the asset and less cash; lower holds more cash. The daily core order moves the split back to this value once it drifts past rebalance_band. At 0 with no asset held, no core order is placed and only buy trades can pass.

target_volatility.description: Target volatility (0.10 = 10%). ONLY active when enable_volatility_adjustment is true (default false). When active, scales position size down if ATR%% of entry exceeds the target (never up).
target_volatility.x-mangrove-effect: With the gate off (the default), changing this has no effect. With it on, lower scales positions down more aggressively in high volatility.
target_volatility.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_mode.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). Volatility is derived from ATR.
volatility_mode.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.

volatility_tolerance.description: Where on the ATR width the stop is taken, as the ATR_long-vs-ATR_short contribution ratio: 0 is all short end (0.5x the signal timeframe's ATR), 1 is all long end (2x the daily ATR). Interpolated geometrically, so the value is exactly the long end's share of log(stop) and each 0.1 is the same multiplicative step. Replaces atr_short_weight, atr_long_weight and atr_cap_multiplier.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher widens the stop, and because position size is the risk budget divided by the stop distance, exposure shrinks in exact inverse proportion at the SAME risk. Low means many units with little room to be wrong and frequent stop-outs; high means few units that are hard to shake out but need a much larger move to reach the same reward.
